entry_points.name: immutable driver tag + crates.io publish
entry_points.trace: vX.Y.Z tag drives release.yml. oracledb 0.9.0 is live on crates.io (2026-07-21) and 0.9.1 (2026-07-23); the repo is tagged v0.9.0 at 2efd7b54 and v0.9.1 at 6c594a0b (workspace version = 0.9.1 at that commit). The operator performed the tag; agents never tag or publish.

limitations: The publication (crates.io) and immutable git tags are external, manually verified facts, not a committed machine artifact in this doc. The sink was defined for 0.9.0; 0.9.1 supersedes it and is also live, so the terminal publish obligation is fully met.
